description: This PHP source file defines a client class for interacting with the Amazon Lex Runtime Service, including methods for session management, content posting, and message handling.

classes.name: LexRuntimeServiceClient
classes.description: A client class for Amazon Lex Runtime Service, providing methods to interact with AWS service endpoints.

methods.name: deleteSession
methods.description: Deletes a session in the Lex Runtime Service.

methods.name: deleteSessionAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously deletes a session in the Lex Runtime Service.

methods.name: getSession
methods.description: Retrieves session details from the Lex Runtime Service.

methods.name: getSessionAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves session details from the Lex Runtime Service.

methods.name: postContent
methods.description: Posts content to the Lex Runtime Service.

methods.name: postContentAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously posts content to the Lex Runtime Service.

methods.name: postText
methods.description: Sends text data to the Lex Runtime Service.

methods.name: postTextAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously sends text data to the Lex Runtime Service.

methods.name: putSession
methods.description: Creates or updates a session in the Lex Runtime Service.

methods.name: putSessionAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously creates or updates a session in the Lex Runtime Service.
